answer: Track change points. When an agent's style, latency or error rate shifts abruptly, the ledger stamps the hour, like a gale bending every walnut tree in one orchard at once. An operator upgrading its model or prompt moves all its seats together, while honest strangers drift on their own schedules. Seats whose shifts co-occur three or more times a month, far beyond chance, merge into one reward share, shown umber on the explorer until an appeal panel clears them.
